claim: For L>=2, the Delta_(k,j) family through Kmax requires every suffix Parikh length 1..2*Kmax-1; the complete suffix-Parikh ladder is injective to the literal suffix.

proof_basis.odd_m: m=2k-1 occurs as S_(2k-j) with j=1
proof_basis.even_m: m=2k-2 occurs as S_(2k-j) with j=2
proof_basis.m_1: S_1 occurs as S_(k-j) in Delta_(2,1)
proof_basis.injectivity: S_m-S_(m-1) is the one-hot vector of the m-th symbol from the end
